## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象开了字段历史时，作者自定义记录页上的讨论/动态面板也显示「谁把哪个字段从多少改成多少」，筛选里出现「仅字段变更」；作者写的 `changes_only` 不再被当成「全部」。
- 为什么改：卡 #33996，按裁决 6996126030 走 A（补实现，不动协议）。
- 风险与回滚：只改界面；面板在屏且对象开了历史时才多一次审计读取（最近 50 条）和一次用户名查询；已有自定义页面板的「全部」会多出变更行。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `historyConsumerOnScreen`；`recordTimelineStream.ts` 的 `mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed`。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx` 和 `recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`，全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、313 行）。L1 意见：可落，裁决附带的两条条件都做到了。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `a715274481ed92c6b305b004655c50e04a4a7f95` · 2026-11-19T04:22Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 9 files, +272/−41, 3 commits. `Fixes #33996`. `check-governed-merges --pr 35311`: 0 of 9 paths governed, 313 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no` holds: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` gains `mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed` in the `recordTimelineStream` module only (not re-exported from the entry); no spec, prop, locale key or entry export changes. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Fixes vs the card and ruling 6996126030 (route A):** the ruling asked for A with two conditions, and both hold. (1) Read only while a panel is on screen: on an assigned page `historyConsumerOnScreen = historyEnabled && feedConsumerOnScreen`, which feeds `historyWanted` and the early return of the read effect; the synthesized-page branch is unchanged. (2) A reader whose audit read is refused is not offered Field Changes: `fieldHistoryShown = historyEnabled && historyEntries !== null` is unchanged, and both panels AND it with their own rule. #30122 pairing is kept: `mergeFieldHistoryIntoFeed` and `mergeTimelineStream` share one `pairedStream`, differing only in sort direction. The ruling's two unmeasured gaps are now measured in the PR body: request count (1 → 3 requests, 2 waves, asserted by the flipped pin) and existing authored pages (showcase's panel is on non-`trackHistory` `showcase_project`; app-crm and hotcrm place no feed panel on an authored record page). Live latency is still unmeasured, and the body says so. So `Fixes` is right.
- **The three points ux-2 named:** (a) The reverse pin "an assigned page of a trackHistory object never reads the audit log" is the exact behaviour route A reverses, so flipping it is the point. It is replaced by the read pin plus three never-read controls (no feed panel on the open tab, no feed panel at all, no `trackHistory`), and ablation 1 reddens exactly the flipped pin and the read-dependent cases. (b) The two hiding rules follow #30074/#30344, which hide an option that filters nothing. `unifiedTimeline: false` drops every `type: 'field_change'` row in `applyFeedConfig`, and activity `created`/`updated`/... rows map to `field_change`, so paired rows (and their diffs) are dropped as well. The panel shows no change, and offering `changes_only` there would be empty. Default-page chatter leaves the changes to the stream, so it has none either. (c) acceptance[7] not flipped is correct: no stock showcase `record:discussion` sits on a `trackHistory` object, and knownGaps[3] now names only the missing stock carrier (revision 16, history row added).
- **What I checked against regressions:** under `unifiedTimeline: false` the pre-PR authored panel already dropped every `updated` activity row (all are `field_change`), so the merge dropping unpaired `updated` rows changes nothing there. The new `changeLines` in `RecordActivityTimeline` applies only on the panel face: on the stream a paired activity row is a system entry and goes through `renderSystemLine`, so it gets no second diff. In `record-activity.tsx` the non-stream `useMemo` already had `fieldChanges` in its deps; in `record-chatter.tsx`, `onDefaultPage` and `fieldChanges` were added.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/33996-authored-feed-field-history.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. I read each sentence against the diff:
  - "reads ... the newest 50 audit entries, plus one user-name lookup ... while one of those panels is on screen" matches the read gate.
  - "an update that wrote both ... is one row, now showing its before and after values" matches `pairedStream` plus `changeLines`.
  - "an `updated` activity row with no audit entry steps aside" matches the `changes.length > 0` guard.
  - The refused-reader sentence matches the unchanged `fieldHistoryShown`.
  - The `unifiedTimeline: false` sentence matches the filter and `fieldHistoryShown` in both renderers.
  - "The default record page is unchanged" holds: the stream path and the default-page chatter take no merge.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) A page whose only on-screen feed block is authored `unifiedTimeline: false` still pays the one 50-row read. The gate judges node types, not props. It is a bounded cost with no correctness effect, and the body says so; no card is owed. (2) The 50-entry window is the default page's: an `updated` row older than it steps aside, as it does on the stream.
- **Pins:**
  - New describe in `recordTimelineStream-27055`: the pure merge (order, pairing, identity when empty), run for both `record:activity` and `record:discussion`. It covers All holds the paired diff once plus the unpaired row; authored `changes_only` opens on Field Changes; CONTROL no history means no Field Changes and the value reads All; and `unifiedTimeline: false`. It also has CONTROL default-page discussion.
  - In app-shell open-waves: the flipped read pin, three controls, and an authored `changes_only` driven through the real view.
  - Ablation 2 reddens only the `record:activity` legs.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `a7152744`: 47 success, 11 skipped, 0 failure. The successes include Test UI and all 16 Test UI shards, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint & Repo Gates, and Check Changeset.
- **范围外去向:** `check:platform-checklist` reports `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix` VARIANTS STALE. This is on `main` after the seed-mode retirement, not in this diff, and is not this card's.
- **落地条款:** K = 7 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `dc53d4a6` (< 15). No locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-2 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT. On MERGED, close-out on #33996.
